evidence.title: README (segment 1)
evidence.excerpt: ## Telegram Web K Based on Webogram, patched and improved. Available for everyone here: https://web.telegram.org/k/

evidence.title: README (segment 2)
evidence.excerpt: ### Developing Install dependencies with: ```lang=bash pnpm install ``` This will install all the needed dependencies.

evidence.title: README (segment 3)
evidence.excerpt: #### Running web-server Just run `pnpm start` to start the web server and the livereload task. Open http://localhost:8080/ in your browser.

evidence.title: README (segment 4)
evidence.excerpt: Run `node build` to build the minimized production version of the app. Copy `public` folder contents to your web server.

evidence.title: README (segment 5)
evidence.excerpt: #### Developing: * Install dependencies `docker-compose up tweb.dependencies`. * Run develop container `docker-compose up tweb.develop `. * Open http://localhost:8080/ in your browser.

evidence.title: README (segment 6)
evidence.excerpt: #### Production: * Run `docker-compose up tweb.production -d` nginx image and container to serve the build * Open http://localhost:80/ in your browser.

evidence.title: README (segment 7)
evidence.excerpt: You can use `docker build -f ./.docker/Dockerfile_production -t {dockerhub-username}/{imageName}:{latest} .` to build your production ready image.
